config.experiment: layer-band2 AR plus continuous-state FGN hybrid v1
config.ar_initialization: earlier trained layer-band2 AR checkpoint; large adds eight initially identity residual blocks
config.state_initialization: same state_s37/best.pt for deterministic and stochastic hybrids; fine-tuned jointly
config.scope: Frozen 960h Zipformer; 100h warm-start continuation pilot. Same-depth det/fgn comparison isolates functional noise in the acoustic-state branch. Not a from-scratch scaling law or a claim of bounded total memory.

hypotheses: band2 AR plus forecast continuous audio beats equal-depth AR continuation
functional noise improves held-out NLL/gain over same-size deterministic hybrid
depth expansion has less held-out degradation with functional noise
warning: One seed and eight continuation epochs. If overfitting is not observed, do not claim that FGN prevented it. Noise is in the future-audio branch, not a generic dropout replacement in AR.
